name: 波普艺术 - 薄荷糖 无字体

styles.container: width: 440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 30px; font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 28px !important; color: #252a34 !important; background-color: #e0f7fa !important; border-radius: 15px; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #4dd0e1; border: 3px solid #000; position: relative; overflow: visible; word-wrap: break-word; display: block;
styles.innerContainer: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 0%, rgba(224, 247, 250, 0.98) 100%); border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px; margin: 24px 0; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); border: 2px dashed #4dd0e1; transform: rotate(1deg); transition: all 0.3s ease;
styles.a: color: #3498db !important; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #3498db; color: var(--pop-primary) !important;
styles.ol: margin: 16px 0; padding: 15px; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) !important; border: 1px dashed #a6a6a6; border-radius: 8px; color: #252a34 !important;
styles.blockquote: margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 10px 20px; background-color: transparent !important; border-left: none; color: #252a34 !important; line-height: 28px !important; font-style: italic;
styles.code: font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14.4px; padding: 2px 5px; background-color: #eaecf1 !important; color: #252a34 !important; border-radius: 4px; line-height: 25.2px;
styles.pre: margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background-color: #2d2d2d !important; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6 !important;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; max-height: 600px !important; height: auto; display: block; margin: 20px auto; border-radius: 8px;
styles.th: background-color: #f0f0f0 !important; padding: 10px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; font-weight: 600;
